There have been 26 prior macro-attempts in this family and 370 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0084/micro-0004 at 1740 parameters and 99.010000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0081/micro-0007 (discard, 98.970000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward input map: union flattened coordinates 79 and 80, values -0.0480845459 and -0.0480485037 (difference 3.604e-05), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: nonlinear feature construction contains near-duplicate scalars independent of QKV redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,739 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-input union (difference 5.056e-05) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test at this new mechanism site. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
